subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils 1/7] nfsdctl: sync nfsd_netlink.h with the kernel

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch updates the nfsd_netlink.h file in the nfs-utils package to match the latest version from the kernel. It imports new attributes related to rpcbind registration, including NFSD_A_SERVER_SOCK_USERSPACE_RPCBIND and NFSD_A_SERVER_SOCK_RPCBIND. The patch also adds a test for these new attributes and bumps the USE_SYSTEM_NFSD_NETLINK_H probe to one of the new attributes. This change is necessary because some hosts may have headers that are newer than v6.9, which introduced NFSD_CMD_SERVER_STATS_GET.
